repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The IR checks if the volume dropped ($v1 - $v2 >= 20), meaning the initial reading must be higher than the final reading. The candidate reversed the operands ($v2 - $v1 >= 20), triggering on a rise instead of a drop. Evidence F2 confirms the JoI emitted the action while the IR did not, as the input held at 20 (a rise from 0) satisfied the wrong condition.
diagnosis.change_summary: Reversed the subtraction order in the `if` condition from `(v2 - v1 >= 20)` to `(v1 - v2 >= 20)` to match the IR's logic for detecting a drop in volume.
